svg.title: The voice tail and the agents' throughput
svg.desc: Each run's voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale against the SLO of 2.03 s, and the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, with each configuration's median: Voice alone, no agents: V2V p95 1.78 s at the median of 5 runs (1.76 to 1.82 s); Tuned vLLM 0.32, the baseline: V2V p95 10.48 s at the median of 10 runs (8.69 to 12.12 s), the agents' 3,305 tokens/s (100% of tuned vLLM's); A router, aborts and resubmits: V2V p95 2.52 s at the median of 5 runs (2.52 to 2.87 s), the agents' 3,332 tokens/s (101% of tuned vLLM's); make-room, #63350: V2V p95 5.09 s at the median of 5 runs (4.69 to 6.26 s), the agents' 3,414 tokens/s (103% of tuned vLLM's); make-room + prefill hold, 16-token window: V2V p95 3.09 s at the median of 5 runs (2.87 to 3.19 s), the agents' 3,298 tokens/s (100% of tuned vLLM's); make-room + prefill hold, 48-token window: V2V p95 2.24 s at the median of 15 runs (2.13 to 2.40 s), the agents' 3,203 tokens/s (97% of tuned vLLM's).
svg.text: seconds, log scale • lower is better
first 240 s of the calls • higher is better
